## At a glance

- **In-world date.** 23 Eelrun 412 CY. The Long Ebb begins on 1 Hollowdark, fifty days away.
- **Party at.** [[Reedholt]], in the tally house, with the [[Harbormaster's Ledger of Vessen]] and the [[Ebb Lantern]].
- **Active Threads.** [[The Silent Bell]], [[Reedrunner Tithe]] and [[The Failing Sluice]].
- **Last Session.** [[Session 2 - Recap]]: the Party climbed the tower of [[The Drowned Chapel]] and took the ledger from [[Sable]].
- **Next.** [[Ilse Corran]] will learn the ledger has been found, and the Party must decide who reads it.

## Active Threads

- [[The Silent Bell]] is active. The bell has stopped ringing since the ledger was taken, and [[Sable]] waits for someone to speak its contents aloud.
- [[Reedrunner Tithe]] is active. Ilse's crew failed to take the lighthouse oil and will escalate against the ferries next.
- [[The Failing Sluice]] is dormant. The Party has seen the silt line on the chapel walls and has not yet visited [[Crookback Sluice]].

## Last Session

- The Party met [[Nib Ashwater]] and learned that the ledger lay in the bell loft.
- The Party beat two [[Mire Drowner]] creatures under the boards of [[Reedholt]].
- [[Sable]] gave the ledger to [[Odalys Ferro]] after the Party spoke the names of the drowned.
- The Party read the ledger and learned the Compact ordered the flood.

## Next

- Decide whom to tell: [[Hobb Tarrow]], the Harbor Council or the village moot.
- The quest [[Keep Gullhook Lit]] runs to the end of the Long Ebb, and someone must be at the lighthouse.
- [[Tamsin Wick]] has an unresolved debt to [[Ilse Corran]].
